topic: 关系代词与关系副词 (Relative Pronouns and Relative Adverbs)
teaching_notes: 同学们好！今天我们来学习“定语从句”的小秘密——如何用“关系词”给名词穿上漂亮的“形容词外套”！当我们想补充说明一个人（用 who/that）、一件物（用 which/that）、一个地方（用 where）或者“某人的东西”（用 whose）时，就可以用这些神奇小词把句子连接起来。注意哦，whose 表示“……的”，后面一定要紧跟它修饰的名词！例如：The girl who is singing is my sister.（正在唱歌的女孩是我妹妹。）/ This is the park where we played soccer.（这是我们踢足球的公园。）

questions.question: The boy ______ broke the classroom window yesterday apologized to the teacher.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 The boy（人），在从句中作主语，应该用关系代词 who。

questions.question: Look at the cute puppy ______ tail is wagging so happily!
questions.explanation: 这里表示“小狗的”尾巴，表示所属关系（……的），应该用关系代词 whose。

questions.question: Is this the storybook ______ you borrowed from the school library last week?
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the storybook（物），在从句中作宾语，用关系代词 which（或 that）。

questions.question: This is the big playground ______ we play basketball every Friday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the big playground（地点），在从句中作地点状语（在操场上），应该用关系副词 where。

questions.question: I met a new student ______ father is a famous scientist.
questions.explanation: 空格后是名词 father，这里指“新同学的”爸爸，用 whose 表示所属关系。

questions.question: The teacher ______ teaches us science is very patient and humorous.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 The teacher（人），在从句中作主语，应用关系代词 who。

questions.question: The movie ______ we watched yesterday evening was extremely exciting.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 The movie（物），在从句中作 watched 的宾语，用关系代词 which。

questions.question: That is the house ______ my grandparents lived twenty years ago.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the house（地点），从句 my grandparents lived 缺少地点状语（住在房子里），因此用 where。

questions.question: Do you know the girl ______ drawing won the first prize in the art competition?
questions.explanation: 这里指“女孩的”画作（drawing），表示所属关系，选择 whose。

questions.question: A dentist is a doctor ______ takes care of people's teeth.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 a doctor（人），从句中作主语，用关系代词 who。

questions.question: The apples ______ fell from the tree were sweet and juicy.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 The apples（物），在从句中作主语，用关系代词 which。

questions.question: The city ______ we visited during the summer holiday was very beautiful.
questions.explanation: 注意！先行词虽然是 city，但从句是 we visited ...（我们访问了城市），city 在从句中作 visited 的直接宾语，所以用关系代词 which，而不是 where。

questions.question: Sunday is the day ______ my family usually goes on a picnic.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the day（时间），在从句中作时间状语（在这一天），用关系副词 when。

questions.question: The man ______ car was stolen yesterday reported it to the police.
questions.explanation: 空格后是名词 car，表达“那个人的汽车”，用表示所属的关系代词 whose。

questions.question: The computer ______ my dad bought for me works very fast.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 The computer（物），作从句中 bought 的宾语，用关系代词 which。

questions.question: This is the quiet room ______ I study every evening.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the quiet room（地点），在从句中作地点状语（在房间里学习），用关系副词 where。

questions.question: The girl ______ is wearing a pink dress is my cousin Lily.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 The girl（人），作从句主语，用关系代词 who。

questions.question: The cat ______ fur is completely black likes sleeping on the sofa.
questions.explanation: 指“猫的”毛发（fur），表所属关系，用 whose。

questions.question: A museum is a place ______ people can see ancient things and history.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 a place（地点），在从句中作地点状语（在博物馆里），用关系副词 where。

questions.question: The song ______ you sang at the music festival was lovely.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 The song（物），作 sang 的宾语，用关系代词 which。

questions.question: The baker ______ made this special birthday cake is very creative.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 The baker（糕点师，人），作从句主语，用关系代词 who。

questions.question: I will never forget the year ______ we won the school football tournament.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the year（时间），在从句中作时间状语（在这一年），用关系副词 when。

questions.question: The library ______ has thousands of books is near our school.
questions.explanation: 注意！从句中缺少主语（has ...），先行词 The library 是物，因此作主语用关系代词 which，而不是 where。

questions.question: The boy ______ house is next to mine is my best friend Tim.
questions.explanation: 表达“男孩的”房子（house），用关系代词 whose。

questions.question: A chef is someone ______ cooks delicious food in a restaurant.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 someone（人），作从句主语，用关系代词 who。

questions.question: The present ______ my parents gave me for my birthday was a bicycle.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 The present（物），作从句中 gave 的直接宾语，用关系代词 which。

questions.question: That is the farm ______ we saw many sheep and cows last spring.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the farm（地点），在从句中作地点状语（在农场里），用关系副词 where。

questions.question: The writer ______ books are popular among kids visited our school today.
questions.explanation: 表达“作者的”书（books），用关系代词 whose。

questions.question: The shoes ______ I bought yesterday are very comfortable.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 The shoes（物），作从句中 bought 的宾语，用关系代词 which。

questions.question: Autumn is the season ______ leaves turn yellow and fall from trees.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the season（时间），在从句中作时间状语（在秋天这个季节），用关系副词 when。
